headline: #252 ANSWERED and #236 answered in the negative. #252: the Light/Dark collapse is a STALE FIGMA FILE, not a bug in scripts/build-figma-model.mjs — checked the model first as instructed. pnpm figma:model emits 45 of 360 variables differing between Light and Dark, while the staging file has 189 mode-aware variables (Semantic 110 + Component 79) with EXACTLY 0 differing. Code is right, Figma was never pushed to; every staging variable also has path=null, i.e. no hirobius plugin-data key, which independently confirms the file has never received a push. The fix is pnpm figma:push, NOT a code change — the opposite of the other branch of that decision. #236: taking the snapshot through use_figma is IMPOSSIBLE, not merely awkward. The carrier ran successfully against staging and returned checksum 90bf34df, but the MCP tool truncates its response at 20 KB and the snapshot payload for 339 variables is several times that; figma:snapshot --ingest verifies a checksum over the exact bytes, so a truncated copy is worthless. This is a transport ceiling, not a permission or token problem. Only the Figma desktop plugin can produce it, because it writes the JSON to disk via Download JSON instead of returning it through a chat. Adrian-only after all. Environment fully verified this session: pnpm install works, pnpm figma:inventory --fetch works (52 pages, 121 assets), the rotated PAT is live.

Adrian DECISION: claude/business-state-issues-42vql1 is green on every CI gate except check:size. The published manifest went 45.43 kB -> 47.46 kB against a 47 kB budget because the manifest now describes 139 components instead of 120 — real content, not bloat. .size-limit.cjs's own header says 'to update a budget, measure a new baseline and justify the change in the PR', so a bump to 55 kB is the sanctioned route, but raising it was refused by this session's safety classifier as a CI bypass and the standing instruction was not to weaken a gate. Options: (a) approve the 47 -> 55 kB bump, (b) drop the duplicate figmaLink field, (c) accept a red check:size. PR NOT opened, per instruction not to open on red
